<decisions>
## Implementation Decisions

### Channel Matrix
- Priority tiers (P0/P1/P2/P3) specifying platform, content type, cadence, and expected reach
- 70/30 split between AI/developer channels and crypto channels
- Grounded in persona locations from Phase 16

### Success Metrics
- API-active developers (>100 calls/month) as primary KPI, not follower counts or Discord members
- Avoid vanity metrics per PITFALLS.md guidance

### Content Calendar Framework
- Map content types to developer journey stages (AAARRRP from Phase 16) and channels
- Use messaging from Phase 17 message house

### Claude's Discretion
All formatting, specific channel selections, and creative content strategy choices at Claude's discretion.
